name: expand the cheapest frontier node
mechanism: keep a frontier of discovered nodes with their best-known cost, repeatedly remove the cheapest, finalise it, and relax its neighbours' costs; adding an admissible estimate of remaining cost to the priority steers the expansion toward a goal
